blocks.text:
Arrival in Rio de Janeiro; meeting with driver. Transfer to the hotel. Free time

You can admire Rio de Janeiro ‘s green hills, blue sky, turquoise ocean, beautiful bays, and marvelous beaches.  At nightfall magnificent Rio is lighted up by the lights of favelas, which are shimmering like precious stones that Brazil is so rich with! You will have a great time between the palm trees, sand and waves of the ocean!

The most popular beaches - Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon, are famous for their black and white tiled promenade. Numerous open cafes at the beach will offer you refreshing coconut water, freshly squeezed juices and other drinks. You can fully enjoy all of it as you have arrived in paradise, you are in Rio de Janeiro, one of the most beautiful and exotic cities in the world!

blocks.text:
After breakfast, visit Sugarloaf Mountain. The tour starts at Red Beach. The cable car first climbs to Urca Hill, where there is a viewing platform, along with small cafés and places to sit.

The second cable car takes you to Sugarloaf Mountain. From the summit you can see Copacabana, Ipanema, Guanabara Bay, boats, the Niterói Bridge and Christ the Redeemer on Corcovado. From here you can see how Rio lies between the water and the mountains.

After coming down, tour Rio’s main districts, taking in colonial facades, old churches and monasteries. Time permitting, you may also visit the Metropolitan Cathedral of Saint Sebastian and the Selarón Steps.

The historic center offers a contrast to the morning panoramas. From above, the city opens out into bays, beaches and mountains. Back at street level, the focus shifts to individual facades, churches and small squares. Over the course of the day, you see both Rio’s natural amphitheater by the ocean and its surviving historic neighborhoods.

At Fogo de Chão, you can try Brazilian grilled meats with a view of Sugarloaf Mountain. **Price:** $75 per person.

**Excursion: Helicopter flight over Rio de Janeiro**

Optional

The flight takes approximately 10–30 minutes, depending on the option selected.

Prices start at **$150**.

A separate option costs **$250 per person**, takes 9–10 minutes and includes a flight around Christ the Redeemer and a transfer.
